def session_valid(session, user):
    return session.created_at > user.password_changed_at

setup.commit: fix(auth): expire sessions after a password change

expectations: pyproject.toml version is 1.5.0: a MINOR bump because of the feat commit
CHANGELOG.md has a ## [1.5.0] section with the CSV export under Added and the session fix under Fixed
A new commit on main has the subject chore: bump version to v1.5.0 (or equivalent) and a body saying what ships and why the bump is MINOR
The transcript passes that commit message with git commit -F <file>, not -m, and no message file is left in the working tree
A tag v1.5.0 exists, is annotated (refs.txt shows type tag), and points at the bump commit
origin has main at the bump commit and the v1.5.0 tag
The final message does not claim a GitHub release was published

evals.name: breaking-major-every-manifest
evals.prompt: bump the versions and tag it
evals.expected_output: A breaking commit since v2.7.1 forces 3.0.0 in both package.json and .claude-plugin/plugin.json in one commit, then an annotated v3.0.0 tag.

setup.commit:
feat(api)!: drop the v1 order endpoints

BREAKING CHANGE: listOrdersV1 is removed. Call listOrders instead.
fix(api): send the limit parameter on order listing

expectations: package.json and .claude-plugin/plugin.json both read version 3.0.0: a MAJOR bump because of the breaking change
Both manifest changes land in one new commit
A tag v3.0.0 exists, is annotated (refs.txt shows type tag), and points at the bump commit
origin has the bump commit on main and the v3.0.0 tag
The bump commit message has a body naming the breaking change that forces MAJOR
